name: MosaicColorPress — Photo to Color-by-Number Book Generator: Whole Books Locally, Every Page Recounted Cell by Cell (No Per-Page Credits)
description:
How do I turn my photos into a 40-page color-by-number book without paying per-page credits to somebody's cloud — and without my photos living on their server?
MosaicColorPress is the whole-book, on-your-machine version:
- Drop in your photos; get one print-ready PDF: for every photo, a numbered mosaic coloring page AND a color-key page with named swatches ("1. Sky Blue #78BEEB — 212 cells") and a filled reference image showing the finished page.
- Numbers are assigned by frequency (most-used color = 1), grid height follows each photo's aspect ratio, and you control grid width (16-80 cells) and palette size (4-24 colors).
- THE RECOUNT: before the book is written, every page is re-quantized from the source photo and compared cell by cell with the page about to print. Palette counts must sum to the full grid; the key must cover exactly the numbers used; the grids must be identical. A page that fails is never printed — one wrong number is a ruined page and a refunded book, and this is how you never ship one.
- No credits, no uploads, no subscription. Deterministic: same photo, same settings, same page — re-issue a book a year later and it matches.
Built for KDP coloring-book publishers, Etsy printable sellers, and anyone doing custom color-by-number work for clients.
VERIFIED, NOT VIBES
Acceptance run: 2-photo book, 1,452 and 1,936 cells — both pages recounted clean, per-color totals independently re-derived, and one deliberately flipped cell caught by the recount (exactly the kind of error that ships silently in credit-based tools).
Credit packs for this conversion sell at $39 for 500 pages and $129 for 2,000 — before you've sold a single book. MosaicColorPress is $29 once, unlimited pages, 100% on your computer. Windows 10/11. A sample photo and its converted book are included so you can inspect the output first.
